description: This is a Java test class for the ThingSearchCommandAdapter, containing unit tests for converting between Adaptable objects and ThingSearchCommand instances, specifically focusing on the search and subscription commands related to 'things'.

classes.name: ThingSearchCommandAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the ThingSearchCommandAdapter, testing conversion between Adaptable and ThingSearchCommand objects, including various subscription commands.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test instance before each test case.

methods.name: unknownCommandToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests that an unknown command throws UnknownCommandException.

methods.name: createSubscriptionFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests creation of a CreateSubscription command from an Adaptable object.

methods.name: createSubscriptionToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of a CreateSubscription to an Adaptable object.

methods.name: createSubscriptionFilterOnlyToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests creation of an Adaptable with only filter field set.

methods.name: createSubscriptionWithFieldsFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests creation of a ThingSearchCommand with fields from an Adaptable.

methods.name: createSubscriptionWithFieldsToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of a CreateSubscription with fields to an Adaptable object.

methods.name: requestSubscriptionFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests creation of a RequestFromSubscription command from an Adaptable object.

methods.name: requestSubscriptionToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of a RequestFromSubscription to an Adaptable object.

methods.name: cancelSubscriptionFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests creation of a CancelSubscription command from an Adaptable object.

methods.name: cancelSubscriptionToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests conversion of a CancelSubscription to an Adaptable object.
